description: This Java class handles the import of shared account data from Excel files into the system. It reads and processes data from a specified worksheet, creates domain objects, serializes them, and sends commands to create shared accounts, updating the sheet with import status.

classes.name: SharedAccountImportHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for importing shared account data from an Excel workbook, processing the data, and executing creation commands while updating import status within the Excel sheet.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point that reads the Excel workbook, processes shared account data, and initiates the import command sequence.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads the shared accounts sheet from the workbook and builds a list of ShareAccountData objects after filtering out already imported records.

methods.name: readSharedAccount
methods.description: Extracts details for a single shared account from a worksheet row and constructs a ShareAccountData object.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Serializes share account data, sends creation commands, updates import status cells, and returns import counts.
